اقتطعوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَعُوا (iqtaṭaʕū) /iq.ta.tˤa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# اُقْتُطِعُوا (uqtuṭiʕū) /uq.tu.tˤi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# اِقْتَطِعُوا (iqtaṭiʕū) /iq.ta.tˤi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
